searchText: This is related to 1559, but I don’t think it fits in the existing channels. Would there be an opportunity at some point in the future to, instead of burn the base fee, put it into a “treasury” for development grants (I think cardano has a treasury)? I just feel like it’s wasteful to burn and the only reason I understand we’re doing it is so that miners don’t collide I can move it to a better channel if this is the wrong one, interested to hear The right place to discuss such things would be the `discussions-to` link on the EIP which can be found at the top of <https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1559>. If you want a real-time discussion, <#692078615269212180> would be most appropriate I think. I merged https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3360 so that the Draft would be visible on master for Magician's discussions. Can I reopen the PR (I see that you did <@!301186049323958275>)? The Github docs say there is a button for that, but there isn't. You can open a new PR from the same branch if you want, but that PR is "done" now that it is merged. OK. That works, <@!301186049323958275>. And the new PR retains the comments from the old PR, (probably because its the same branch) so the continuity of the review is maintained. PR comments won't be retained. I got lost in the clutter. They aren't 😦 My confusion - old PR was #3360, new PR is #3366.

I just feel like it’s wasteful to burn and the only reason I understand we’re doing it is so that miners don’t collide

excerpts.content: I merged https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3360 so that the Draft would be visible on master for Magician's discussions.  Can I reopen the PR (I see that you did <@!301186049323958275>)?  The Github docs say there is a button for that, but there isn't.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: You can open a new PR from the same branch if you want, but that PR is "done" now that it is merged.
